rule: Does a patient's own graph completeness (how many of their 12 CoW vessels are actually visible/segmented, 0-12) predict segmentation reliability (Dice)? A different signal from the triage check (which used the PREDICTION's own laterality/volume) -- this uses only the INPUT graph's structure, known before any inference happens.
pass_mark: Spearman rho > 0 and p < 0.05, fixed before running
